snippet.title: RoboSquare: Recharged - Trailer
snippet.description:
RoboSquare: Recharged is finally here!! With a completely new vision, the original RoboSquare game brings a significantly more unique experience for you and your friends! 

RoboSquare: Recharged is a chaotic online party game for up to 16 players. Race your friends, knock them off the map, survive ridiculous minigames, and fight for the crown. Easy to pick up, significantly harder when your friends are trying to ruin your life.

Grab some friends and play on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4088870?utm_source=yt_trailer
